description: Standardize Pick Instance architecture and UI - Create canonical presentation model and reusable components for consistent pick display across all views

userStories.title: Create PickPresenter view model for canonical display values
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a presentation layer that takes a Bet model and produces standardized display strings so all views render picks consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Services/PickPresenter.swift
Struct PickPresenter with init(bet: Bet, event: Event?, playerName: String? = nil)
Property `title: String` — singles: 'Houston Rockets -2.5 (-110)' (selection + odds), multi-picks: 'Multi-Pick · {N} Selections · {combinedOdds}'
Property `contextLine: String` — 'NBA · Houston @ Charlotte', with optional player prefix for bookie views
Property `stakeLine: String` — '$10 Stake'
Property `profitLine: String` — '+$9.09 Profit' (green) or '-$10.00' (red) for settled, 'Potential: +$9.09' for open
Property `settlementStatus: SettlementStatus` enum with cases: open, won, lost, push, void, cancelled
Property `workflowStatus: WorkflowStatus` enum with cases: pending, approved, rejected
Static method to map BetStatus + GradeResult to (SettlementStatus, WorkflowStatus) tuple
Property `isMultiPick: Bool`
File line count must remain within expected range for a new file (~120-160 lines)
Do NOT modify any existing files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the canonical presentation model from the PRD. BetStatus maps to the two-axis system: pending/accepted → workflow=pending/approved + settlement=open. graded/settled with .win → settlement=won. graded/settled with .loss → settlement=lost. declined → workflow=rejected. void → settlement=void. Use LiabilityService.calculatePayout(stake:odds:) for profit calculation. American odds formatting: positive gets '+' prefix. Event name format: 'awayTeam @ homeTeam'. For multi-picks, take an array of Bets sharing a ticketId. combinedOdds calculated from all legs.

userStories.title: Create StatusPill reusable component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable status pill view that renders settlement status with consistent colors everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Views/Components/StatusPill.swift
View takes a SettlementStatus (from PickPresenter) and optional WorkflowStatus
Settlement status controls pill color: open → Theme.scheduled, won → Theme.accent, lost → Theme.danger, push → Theme.textMuted, void → Theme.textMuted, cancelled → Theme.textMuted
Settlement status controls label: 'Open', 'Won', 'Lost', 'Push', 'Void', 'Cancelled'
If workflow status is .pending, show small 'Pending' text below the pill in Theme.warning
If workflow status is .rejected, show 'Rejected' pill in Theme.danger instead of settlement status
Pill uses capsule shape, Theme.font(size: 12, weight: .semibold), horizontal padding 10, vertical padding 4
Do NOT modify any existing files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This replaces all the inline status coloring and labeling across views. The key insight is that settlement status drives the primary visual, and workflow status is secondary metadata. Use .background(statusColor.opacity(0.15)) with .foregroundStyle(statusColor) for the pill styling, matching existing Theme patterns.

userStories.title: Create SelectionRow reusable component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable row view for displaying a single selection (bet leg) with consistent formatting.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Views/Components/SelectionRow.swift
View takes: selectionLabel (String), odds (Int), eventName (String), league (String?), gradeResult (GradeResult? for settled legs)
Line 1: selection label + formatted odds — e.g., 'Houston Rockets -2.5 (-110)'
Line 2: league + event — e.g., 'NBA · Houston @ Charlotte'
If gradeResult is present, show small result indicator (green dot for win, red for loss, gray for push)
Uses Theme.textPrimary for line 1, Theme.textSecondary for line 2
Font: Theme.bodyFont(size: 15) for line 1, Theme.bodyFont(size: 13) for line 2
Do NOT modify any existing files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This component is used inside both compact cards and detail views. The selection label comes from bet.side (e.g., 'Houston Rockets -2.5'). Odds formatting: positive gets '+' prefix. League might be nil if not available. Keep the component simple — it just displays, no interaction.

userStories.title: Create PickCardCompact reusable list row component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable compact pick card for use in all list views that follows the canonical hierarchy from the PRD.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Views/Components/PickCardCompact.swift
View takes a PickPresenter instance
Layout: VStack(left-aligned) with HStack for title + status pill
Line 1 (HStack): title (left) + StatusPill (right)
Line 2: contextLine in Theme.textSecondary
Line 3: stakeLine + profitLine in Theme.textSecondary, profit colored green/red
If workflow status is .pending, show subtle 'Pending' label below title
Card uses Theme.cardBackground with standard padding and corner radius
Works for both singles and multi-picks (PickPresenter handles formatting)
Do NOT modify any existing files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the primary reusable card that replaces BetRowView, PlayerBetRowView, TicketHeaderView, etc. The PickPresenter provides all the display strings so the card just lays them out. The card should match the existing visual density of BetRowView. No interaction — wrapping views handle NavigationLink etc.

userStories.title: Create PickDetailHeader reusable component for detail views
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable header component for pick detail screens that shows the expanded pick summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Views/Components/PickDetailHeader.swift
View takes a PickPresenter instance
Section 1 — Pick Summary: Type (Single/Multi-Pick), Stake, Combined Odds, StatusPill
Section 2 — Financials: If open, show 'Potential Profit' and 'Total Return'. If settled, show 'Final Profit' and 'Final Payout'. Never show both potential and final simultaneously.
Uses LabeledContent-style rows with label left, value right
Financial values colored: profit green if positive, red if negative
Uses Theme styling throughout
Do NOT modify any existing files
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This header replaces the top sections of TicketDetailView and BetDetailView. The PickPresenter already computes profitLine and whether the pick is settled. For Total Return, calculate stake + profit. Section styling should match existing Theme.cardBackground card patterns.

userStories.title: Add multi-pick support to PickPresenter
userStories.description: As a developer, I need PickPresenter to handle multi-pick (parlay) tickets by accepting an array of bets and computing combined display values.
acceptanceCriteria: Add static factory method: PickPresenter.multiPick(bets: [Bet], events: [Event], playerName: String?) -> PickPresenter
Multi-pick title: 'Multi-Pick · {N} Selections · {combinedOdds}'
Combined odds calculated from all legs (multiply decimal odds, convert back to American)
Stake comes from first bet's stake (parlay stake is on each leg identically)
Profit calculated from combined odds × stake
Property `selections: [SelectionInfo]` struct with (label, odds, eventName, league, gradeResult) for each leg
settlementStatus derived from all legs: all won → won, any lost → lost, all push → push, mix of graded/ungraded → open
Do NOT modify any existing files except PickPresenter.swift
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Parlay odds calculation: convert each leg's American odds to decimal, multiply together, convert back to American. Use the existing americanToDecimal/decimalToAmerican helper pattern from BetsListView. The selections array is used by SelectionRow in detail views to show each leg.

userStories.title: Refactor BetsListView (BetRowView) to use PickCardCompact
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to replace the custom BetRowView in BetsListView with the standardized PickCardCompact component.
acceptanceCriteria: BetRowView body uses PickCardCompact with a PickPresenter built from its bet/event data
For multi-picks, use PickPresenter.multiPick() with all bets sharing the same ticketId
Parlay partial grading info (ParlayPartialInfo) still displays if applicable
Policy violation reason still shows for pending picks
NavigationLink to BetDetailView still works
Visual output matches the canonical hierarchy: title + status, context, financial
File line count must remain within ±50 lines of original — preserve all existing logic
Do NOT delete BetRowView — refactor its body to delegate to PickCardCompact
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: BetRowView currently takes (bet, eventName, betDisplayName, sportLeague, policyViolationReason, parlayInfo). Construct a PickPresenter from these params and pass to PickCardCompact. Keep the ParlayPartialInfo badge as an overlay or additional element — PickCardCompact is the base, extra bookie-specific info layers on top. BetsListView.swift contains BetRowView, BetDetailView — only change BetRowView.

userStories.title: Refactor TrackView ticket rows to use shared components
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to refactor TicketHeaderView and TicketBetRowView in TrackView to use PickCardCompact and SelectionRow.
acceptanceCriteria: TicketHeaderView uses PickCardCompact (with PickPresenter.multiPick for parlays, or single PickPresenter for singles)
TicketBetRowView uses SelectionRow for individual legs within a ticket
Parlay leg status dots still show grading progress
NavigationLink to TicketDetailView still works
Visual hierarchy matches canonical format
File line count must remain within ±50 lines of original
Do NOT delete existing views — refactor their bodies
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: TrackView groups bets into Ticket structs by ticketId. The Ticket struct and grouping logic stays as-is — only the row rendering changes. TicketHeaderView currently shows displayName, stake, payout, status — this maps directly to PickCardCompact. The mini status dots for parlay legs are a TrackView-specific addition on top of the base card.

userStories.title: Refactor PlayerBetRowView and GradingBetRow to use shared components
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to refactor the pick rows in PlayersListView and GradingView to use the shared component system.
acceptanceCriteria: PlayerBetRowView (in PlayersListView.swift) uses PickCardCompact for display
GradingBetRow (in GradingView.swift) uses SelectionRow for the pick info, keeping its unique grading action buttons below
ParlayLegRow uses SelectionRow for the leg display, keeping its mini grading buttons
All views maintain their existing interactive functionality (grading buttons, navigation)
File line counts must remain within ±50 lines of originals
Do NOT delete existing views — refactor their bodies to use shared components where appropriate
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: GradingBetRow and ParlayLegRow have unique grading UI (Win/Loss/Push/Void buttons, suggested outcome) that can't be replaced by PickCardCompact. Instead, use SelectionRow for the pick info portion and keep the grading controls as-is. PlayerBetRowView is simpler and can fully adopt PickCardCompact.

userStories.title: Refactor TicketDetailView to use PickDetailHeader and SelectionRow
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to refactor the TicketDetailView header and bet rows to use the shared detail components.
acceptanceCriteria: TicketDetailView top section uses PickDetailHeader for the summary (type, stake, odds, status, financials)
TicketDetailBetRowView uses SelectionRow for each bet/leg display
Parlay outcome section (WIN/LOST/PUSHED badge, odds breakdown) stays as-is — it's unique to this view
Status display uses StatusPill instead of inline color logic
Financial labels use standardized terms: 'Stake', 'Profit', 'Total Return'
File line count must remain within ±80 lines of original
Do NOT delete existing views — refactor to use shared components
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: TicketDetailView is the most complex detail screen (~1100 lines). The parlay outcome section with odds breakdown is unique and should stay. Replace the header summary and individual bet rows with shared components. The adjusted odds display for voided/pushed legs also stays as-is.

userStories.title: Standardize financial labels and status language across remaining views
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure all remaining views use the standardized financial labels (Stake/Profit/Total Return) and status language.
acceptanceCriteria: AccountView pick display uses 'Stake' and 'Profit' (not 'Potential Return' or 'Payout')
BetDetailView (in BetsListView.swift) uses PickDetailHeader or at minimum standardized labels
DashboardView PendingBetRow uses consistent terminology
All StatusPill colors follow the canonical mapping (no inline status color overrides)
No view uses 'Potential Return', 'To Win', or 'Payout' — only 'Stake', 'Profit', 'Total Return'
No view uses 'Accepted' as a primary status — use 'Open' (settlement) with optional 'Approved' (workflow)
File line counts must remain within ±20 lines of originals
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a sweep story to catch any remaining inconsistencies after the component refactors. Focus on string literals in views not fully refactored in earlier stories. BetDetailView in BetsListView.swift is a large detail view (~400 lines) that should adopt PickDetailHeader if feasible, or at minimum use consistent labels.

userStories.title: Final consistency audit across all pick-displaying views
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify that all views follow the canonical pick display hierarchy and use shared components.
acceptanceCriteria: Grep all Views/*.swift for 'Potential Return', 'To Win', 'Payout' in string literals — none should remain (except 'Total Return' which is approved)
Grep for 'Accepted' used as a primary status display — should only appear as workflow metadata, not main status
Verify PickCardCompact is used in: BetsListView, TrackView, PlayersListView
Verify SelectionRow is used in: TrackView legs, GradingView, TicketDetailView
Verify StatusPill is used in all views that show pick status
Verify PickDetailHeader is used in TicketDetailView and/or BetDetailView
All multi-pick titles follow format: 'Multi-Pick · {N} Selections · {odds}'
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Final safety net story. Check that the refactor is complete and consistent. Fix any remaining deviations. The goal: any developer looking at pick display code sees the same component patterns everywhere.
